title: SICKLEMOOR joins the Games Library: 49 paid games, still $14.99
body:
SICKLEMOOR has joined the CSAF Games Library (2026-11-14). That makes 49 paid games on this page, still $14.99.

SICKLEMOOR is a short action RPG for Windows: one 28 day season on a moorland smallholding, and four barrows of real time sword fights under the moor. By day you clear, till, sow and water three crops, cook what you grow at the cabin hearth, feed the byre and talk to six villagers. At dusk the moor gate opens and you go down with the stamina the day left you and the meals in your pack, because a meal is the only healing below. Every blow is drawn on the floor before it lands, and each of the four keepers, the Barrow Wight, the Banshee, the Mummy King and the Lich, asks for a different read. What you carry home from a barrow makes the next week on the farm easier.

It has no page of its own yet, so for now this Library is the only place to get it. A page of its own, with a free browser demo of the first week and the Low Barrow, is planned.

If you own the Library: SICKLEMOOR is inside the "Action and adventure, part 1" download, which now holds 6 games (about 662 MB). Download part 1 again to get it. In every other download only the small Readme, catalogue and licence text files changed (they now list 49 games), so there is nothing else you need to download again.

Also new on the page: the cover and plates show the new count, SICKLEMOOR has a line under Latest additions, and its GIF is in the gallery until it has a page of its own.

If the Library gives you a good evening, a quick rating helps more than anything.
